Exercise: Smith Machine Leg Press

Category:
strength

Exercise Type:
compound

Force Type:
push

Difficulty Level:
intermediate

Movement Patterns:

- knee_flexion
- hip_extension

Primary Muscles:

- quadriceps

Secondary Muscles:

- calves
- glutes
- hamstrings

Equipment:

- machine

Fatigue Score:
3

Systemic Fatigue:
low

Stimulus To Fatigue Ratio:
0.8

Energy Requirement:
moderate

Recovery Time:
24 hours

Goals:

- quadriceps_hypertrophy
- lower_body_strength

Contraindications:

- condition: recent knee surgery, reason: potential strain on the healing tissue
- condition: severe osteoporosis, reason: increased risk of bone fractures

Exercise Variations:

- name: Smith Machine Leg Press with Smith Machine Bar Lowered, force: push, level: intermediate, mechanic: compound, primaryMuscles: ['quadriceps'], secondaryMuscles: ['calves', 'glutes', 'hamstrings']

Substitution Options:

- name: Squats, equipment: bodyweight or barbell
- name: Barbell Leg Press, equipment: machine

Instructions:

- Position a Smith machine bar a couple feet off of the ground. Ensure that it is resting on the safeties. After loading the bar to an appropriate weight, lie underneath the bar. Place the middle of your feet on the bar, tucking your knees to your chest. This will be your starting position.
- Begin the movement by driving through your feet to move the bar upward, extending the hips and knees. Do not lock out your knees.
- At the top of the motion, pause briefly before returning to the starting position.
